meta_description: Wellgate Painters in Sheffield offer interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Professional finish, competitive rates. Call 07807 002089.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full property redecoration, we transform your space with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether you need interior redecoration, exterior painting, or specialist finishes, we deliver quality results on time and within budget.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full room redecorations, feature walls, and ceiling work. We prep thoroughly, use premium finishes, and leave your space spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint for homes, sheds, and outbuildings. We work around your schedule and protect your garden during application.

services.title: Wallpapering & Hanging
services.desc: Professional wallpaper selection, hanging, and removal. Perfect pattern matching and clean removal of old paper without damage.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Painting and varnishing of doors, skirting boards, and window frames. Quality finishes that last and enhance your property's appeal.

services.title: Facia & Soffit Work
services.desc: Painting and maintenance of fascia boards and soffits. We identify damage early and apply durable protective coatings.

services.title: Colour Consultation
services.desc: Expert advice on colour schemes and finishes that suit your home's architecture and lighting. Help choosing the perfect palette.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like our own — attention to detail, no cutting corners, fair pricing.
about_para_1: Wellgate Painters has been transforming Sheffield homes and businesses for over a decade. We started because we were tired of unreliable decorators and overpriced quotes. Today, we're known throughout Rotherham and Sheffield for showing up on time, delivering quality finishes, and treating customers' homes with genuine respect.
about_para_2: Our customers return because they know what to expect: honest advice, no hidden charges, and a tidy finish every time. We use quality materials, take pride in preparation work, and listen to what you actually want — not what we think looks best.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our lounge redecorated and it looks fantastic. The lads were tidy, professional, and didn't leave a mess. Finished exactly when they said they would. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Got a free quote, no pressure to book, and the actual work was done to a really high standard. Our hallway looks incredible. Will definitely be calling them back for the kitchen.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Needed our front door and fascia painted before selling. They came out, gave honest advice about what needed doing, and completed it all in one day. Fair price and no faffing about. Top quality work.
reviews.author: David M.
